consent_event_evidence_check.name: consent_event_evidence_check
consent_event_evidence_check.value: "consent_event"."method" not in ('STAFF_WRITTEN', 'STAFF_VERBAL') or "consent_event"."decision" not in ('GRANTED', 'RENEWED') or length(trim(coalesce("consent_event"."evidence_ref", ''))) > 0

consent_event_legacy_check.name: consent_event_legacy_check
consent_event_legacy_check.value: "consent_event"."method" <> 'IMPORT_LEGACY' or ("consent_event"."actor_id" is null and "consent_event"."policy_version_id" is null and "consent_event"."decision" = 'GRANTED')

consent_policy_version_published_check.name: consent_policy_version_published_check
consent_policy_version_published_check.value: ("consent_policy_version"."status" = 'DRAFT' and "consent_policy_version"."published_at" is null) or ("consent_policy_version"."status" = 'PUBLISHED' and "consent_policy_version"."published_at" is not null and "consent_policy_version"."effective_at" is not null)

legal_hold_scope_check.name: legal_hold_scope_check
legal_hold_scope_check.value: ("legal_hold"."scope" = 'ACADEMY' and "legal_hold"."player_id" is null) or ("legal_hold"."scope" = 'PLAYER' and "legal_hold"."player_id" is not null)
